summary: POSCO Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of its third-quarter 2026 provisional earnings announcement and business plan briefing, scheduled for November 2, 2026 at 15:00 KST via conference call for analysts, institutional investors and press, with a Q&A session. No transaction, stake, price, premium or advisor is disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings-call scheduling notice equivalent to a US Form 8-K Item 2.02/7.01 announcement. No deal terms, structural mechanics or regulatory clock apply; no risk-arb angle exists, and attention centers solely on quarterly results and capex guidance.
